(Detects flying enemies)|Former Inventory Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Executioner''' is a ranged ground [[tower]] that was unlocked by triumphing [[Totality Tower]]. It could have also been obtained through a gamepass for {{Robux|750}} during the [[Solar Eclipse Event]]. The '''Executioner's''' most recent sale has it require {{Robux|799}} to purchase. The '''Executioner''' attacks by throwing its axe at an enemy, hitting the enemy and bouncing to other enemies. If there is only one enemy in its range, the axe will simply deal damage once. For cases of there being two or more enemies, it will bounce between a specific number of max targets for a specific number of times. For instance, with a max bounce statistic of 15, it will bounce 15 times, however, due to its max targets statistic being 5 in this scenario, it will only bounce 15 times between 5 enemies. With each hit, the axe will boost its damage by a specific number. The '''Executioner''' will with each throw start a small windup before throwing, which is followed by the axe flying between enemies. This has a max flight time of 0.4 for each target. Once it has hit the last enemy, it will take a max of 0.55 seconds to return to the tower, making the '''Executioner''' catch it for 0.1 seconds. Once the axe has been caught, the proper firerate will begin. The '''Executioner's''' high damage and ability to damage multiple enemies makes it a great tower for area of effect. However, it is very weak against singular enemies, with its DPS being significantly reduced if there is just one enemy in its range. The '''Executioner''' has hidden detection at Level 3 and flying detection at Level 0. The '''Executioner''' has a placement limit of 9 per player. ==Upgrades== {{Upgrade|Level = Level 1|Upgrade Title = Quick Chopping|Cost = {{Money|450}}|Image = [[File:ExecutionerUpgrade1.png|100px]]|Information = +2 Range [[File:Range Icon.png|20px|Range]] 1 > 0.75 Firerate [[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Firerate]] Sell price changes to {{Money|750}}}} {{Upgrade|Level = Level 2|Upgrade Title = Double-Headed Axe|Cost = {{Money|1,777}}|Image=[[File:ExecutionerUpgrade2.png|100px]]|Information = +7 Damage [[File:Damage Icon.png|20px|Damage]] +1 Max Targets +1 Max Bounces Sell price changes to {{Money|1,342}}}} {{Upgrade|Level = Level 3|Upgrade Title = Cloaked Revenant|Cost = {{Money|3,750}}|Image=[[File:ExecutionerUpgrade3.png|100px]]|Information = +6 Damage [[File:Damage Icon.png|20px|Damage]] +Hidden Detection {{Hidden|Hidden Detection}} +1 Max Bounces +6 Added Damage [[File:Damage Icon.png|20px|Added Damage]] Sell price changes to {{Money|2,592}}}} {{Upgrade|Level = Level 4|Upgrade Title = Ghoul Shreddin'|Cost = {{Money|6,750}}|Image=[[File:ExecutionerUpgrade4.png|100px]]|Information = +20 Damage [[File:Damage Icon.png|20px|Damage]] +2 Max Targets +2 Max Bounces +1 Added Damage [[File:Damage Icon.png|20px|Added Damage]] Sell price changes to {{Money|4,842}}}} {{Upgrade|Level = Level 5|Upgrade Title = The Judge & The Jury|Cost = {{Money|13,500}}|Image=[[File:ExecutionerUpgrade5.png|100px]]|Information = +2 Range [[File:Range Icon.png|20px|Range]] 0.75 > 0.5 Firerate [[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Firerate]] +10 Damage [[File:Damage Icon.png|20px|Damage]] +1 Max Targets +3 Max Bounces +2 Added Damage [[File:Damage Icon.png|20px|Added Damage]] Sell price changes to {{Money|9,342}}}} ==Statistics== ''To see all the previous statistics of this tower, see the [[/History|history]] page.'' {{neow| $MDPS$ = Damage / (Firerate + Windup + Catch Time + Max Flight Time + Max Return Time) $DPS$ = (Bounces * (2 * Damage + (Bounces - ''Romantic Reaper'' [[Mission Quests|Mission Quest]] |} ==Strategy== *Because of how the '''Executioner''' works, it is strictly an AOE tower, requiring at least two enemies to properly reach its full potential. **Using it on a single enemy will result in extremely low DPS due to the axe not being able to bounce on one enemy. This makes the '''Executioner''' a horrible choice for any single target enemies. *Each hit of the '''Executioner's''' axe can trigger a firework from the [[Firework Technician]]. **Since usually the axe will be hitting multiple times, it will drastically increase the odds of getting a firework by sheer quantity, which will also greatly increase the '''Executioner's''' damage output. *Due to the '''Executioner's''' ability to damage multiple enemies, this can be used as a great tower to clear out hordes of weaker enemies and even minor bosses at Level 5. *The '''Executioner''' gains hidden detection at Level 3, however because of how expensive it is to upgrade it to that level, it is recommended to bring other towers with cheap hidden detection. **Later on in the game, the '''Executioner''' can deal with hordes of high health hidden enemies, like the [[Soul]] and [[Elite Phantom]]. **Although the axe itself may travel through them, the axe will only end up damaging the enemy it bounced to, meaning it cannot be used to indirectly kill such enemies. *The '''Executioner''' can do well against enemies that summon other enemies on death, like the [[Mystery]], as it can both damage the [[Mystery]] and the enemy it spawned if you are lucky enough. *The '''Executioner''' can detect flying enemies, making it useful in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode against enemies like the [[Void Floater]] and in [[Pizza Party]] against [[Balloon Kid]]s. **However, the '''Executioner''' cannot damage [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] enemies. *Towers that can slow down enemies, like the [[Electroshocker]], [[Toxic Gunner]] or [[Sledger]] are very useful with the '''Executioner''', as they let enemies stay in its range for longer and helping to make sure there are more than one enemy in its range at once. **Range boosting towers like the [[DJ Booth]] can also be useful for this. *Due to the '''Executioner''' only having its firerate start once it has caught its axe, which will only start once the windup ends, then the axe stops travelling and is caught. This results in the '''Executioner''' being very ineffective with [[Firerate Buff]]s. **[[Damage Buff]] however are very effective with it, as not only will they boost the damage itself but also how much damage is increased per hit. For instance, a 20% [[Damage Buff]] will boost the damage itself from 50 to 60 and the added damage from 15 to 18 at Level 5. ==Trivia== *The '''Executioner''' is the second ground tower that can detect flying enemies, with the first being the [[Hunter]]. *The '''Executioner''' may originally have based been on the [[w:c:clashroyale:Executioner|Executioner]] card from ''Clash Royale'' and the [https://www.bloonswiki.com/Boomerang_Monkey Boomerang Thrower] from the ''Bloons Tower Defense'' game series. **The former store description of the '''Executioner''' is a reference to the ''Avatar: The Last Airbender'' franchise. **The '''Executioner's''' flying detection may have also been based on the [[w:c:clashroyale:Executioner|Executioner]] card's ability to attack air troops. *The '''Executioner''' has a love for rodents, specifically guinea pigs, rats, and hamsters, as revealed by his concept artist, [https://x.com/tyronedag0at| @tyronedag0at] on X.https://x.com/tyronedag0at_/status/2103784994493944072 ==Update History== ''For previous cosmetic variations, see the [[/Gallery|gallery]] page.'' {{scroll|text = *'''13 December 2021''' -
